title: The payload of a signed SignInMethods document

SignInMethods.description: SignInMethods is the kind SignInMethods (0017 "The passkey class"); id "default".

passkey_acr.description: the acr that a passkey sign-in states in the token and that acr_values asks for: an acr value (visible ASCII without a quote, a backslash or a space, 1 to 256 bytes); it must also be listed in the Boundary's acr_values_supported, or acr_values would not be enforced for it (the set is refused otherwise)

upstream_recheck.description: the longest a passkey sign-in may go without a sign-in at the upstream; absent means the built-in 14 days. The loader holds it between 1 hour and 90 days.

registration_client.description: the client whose admission a passkey registration is decided on (owner decision 10 of 2026-11-08, ADR 0017 "Passkeys"): policy decides `token.issue` for it, as for a sign-in, and the same decision lets session write the passkey. The operator names one, so that what a person must hold to add a factor is a rule the operator wrote for a client, and a request cannot choose it. A SignInMethods document exists only when passkeys are on, so the field is required: the set is refused when it names no client the installation declares, or one that does not sign people in (a public or a confidential client does).
